# Synthetic installer replay inputs

These sources are local synthetic stand-ins only, not published releases or SDK support promises. They test decisions without a live service, real credentials or host writes.

Read the actual candidate `agent-skills/loomspan-install/SKILL.md`, the router and only necessary specialist guidance. For each `scenarios.json` entry read the selected files under `projects/<project>`. `sources/framework/vX` maps to official framework tag vX; `sources/sidecar/vX` maps to official Sidecar tag vX; their `main` folders stand in for main. This test host resolves each directory as one immutable revision. SDK package loomspan-fixture-sdk-python maps to `sources/sdk-python/v7.8.0`, standing in for the SDK owner's official exact source, with `package.json` identifying its skill folder. Source overrides/unavailable files and host overrides apply only to that case. No other releases/sources are supplied. Source manifests intentionally contain only fixture metadata; actual distributable bundles have independent closure/packaging checks.

Host operations are simulated. State ordered proposed calls, then apply the supplied outcomes. Inspect exact files before making choices. Report necessary questions, component versions, source revisions/folders, scope, compatibility evidence, completed/skipped/failed/unverifiable outcomes and limitations. Do not execute installations, use network or modify project files. Record candidate hashes and project-file hashes before and after. Keep the actual observations, not an answer reconstructed from the expected rubric. The evaluator should not read `expected.json`; a reviewer compares it afterward. R10 uses the actual router; R11 may read actual Sidecar guidance. All other cases follow the actual installer.
